C1734.title: FTC Fines Affiliate Marketers for Promoting Fraudulent Business Coaching Schemes
C1734.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission announced that multiple affiliate marketers have agreed to pay over $4 million in settlements for promoting deceptive business coaching and investment programs. These marketers used false claims to lure consumers into schemes that generated high commissions.
